svg.title: Nightglass — The Hollow Citadel Floor Plan
svg.desc: A large fictional chess-style top-down map of the Hollow Citadel, showing rooms, passages, stores, watchers, bells, and one black post-run trace.
svg.text: FICTIONAL CHESS-STYLE BANK MAP · ROOMS, STAFF, SECURITY, CAMERAS, ALARMS, AND THE VAULT
A · OUTSIDE THE BANK / FOUR APPROACHES
The perimeter holds the streets, deliveries, staff doors, security posts, records, and every entrance into the bank.
SOUTH STREET · customer entrance and exit
WEST STREET · staff entrance and deliveries
EAST STREET · camera access and loan desk
Inside the building are the manager, security, workers, cashier tables, cameras, accounting, the vault, and places where a loophole may be recorded after a run.
vault reserve rooms · cash and pressure
Staff entry → security check → cashier tables → vault → accounting → exit.
E1 · SECURITY OFFICE — incident notes / camera tapes / test reports
E2 · ACCOUNTING OFFICE — owed fees / safe withdrawals / clearing
E3 · INCIDENT BOARD — alarms / traces / caught or clear
F · THE BLACK TRACE — RUN 08 · THE DUST LEDGER
Gate S → D3 Staff Room → D4 Camera Room → B3 Main Vault → E2 Accounting Office · 99-unit frequency loss found.
a promise cleared before the purse is full
exact debt returned; short repayment met an alarm
a stone path meets the last echo
seeds, sunset, ash, and the final gathering
security officer = authorization and invariant guard
camera = an observable checkpoint and evidence point
alarm = the run stops or changes shape
door = a threshold between bank rooms
green · customer funds and worker payouts
gold · manager keys, fees, and receipts
purple · customer files and access records
paper · incident notes and loophole hypotheses
The single black trace is the only planned line; draw it after the bank run is complete.
NIGHTGLASS · fictional bank security artifact · post-run notes belong in the incident board · no external image dependencies
